sentence: This project builds a tool that uses light to profile the transcriptomic states of individual cells within chosen areas of tissue.
This project holds a symposium where researchers share research and perspectives about arthritis and related autoimmune diseases.
This project builds deep learning methods that lower the radiation dose of X-ray scans that image the heart.
This project studies the molecular, genetic and cellular mechanisms that drive cancer and develops targeted therapeutic strategies.
This project tries to find out how glioblastoma resists treatment and tests therapies that target the cancer.
This project studies how signaling pathways controlled by a chromatin remodeling protein interact during synaptic homeostatic plasticity in the nervous system.
This project builds a mobile intervention that gives personalized feedback to help stop mood symptoms from turning into depressive episodes and suicidal behavior.
This project offers reservoir assays and sequencing to support research on HIV reservoirs, cure, and vaccine immunogen design.
This project tries to find out how a region of the hypothalamus changes adult hippocampal neurogenesis and how that affects brain-wide network activity.
This project builds a mass spectrometry-based platform that detects autoantibodies to help diagnose autoimmune diseases such as systemic sclerosis.
This project builds computer models to study how information in the ear leads to auditory behavior and how ear impairments change it.
This project tries to develop a treatment that targets breast cancer cells that persist despite current treatments.
This project tests whether inspiratory muscle strength training lowers blood pressure and improves vascular endothelial function in postmenopausal women compared with aerobic exercise.
This project studies how motile cilia in the fallopian tubes move and builds a fiber-based endoscope to image them in vivo.
This project builds a platform that combines Nanopore direct RNA sequencing and mass spectrometry to map RNA modifications across the transcriptome.
This project studies how a transcription factor helps cholangiocytes and immune cells signal to each other in biliary fibrosis.
This project studies how the medial entorhinal cortex represents visual information, using electrophysiology, anatomical tracing and optogenetic manipulation of neural circuits.
This project tries to find out how human chromatin remodeling complexes are assembled and what they do.
This project studies how changes in the fusion protein of respiratory syncytial virus affect the antibodies used to prevent infection.
This project studies how influenza virus and human immunodeficiency virus enter host cells and how that entry can be stopped.
